entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I returned the desk lamp two weeks ago and the refund still has not arrived.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The return tracking says your warehouse received it on June 26. This is synthetic order SYN-4102.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can see the return receipt. Was the original payment by card or store credit?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Card. I checked both pending transactions and the statement this morning.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The refund was approved on July 1, but the processor has not completed the transfer.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Our return screen says completed because the warehouse inspection is done. That does not mean the money has reached your card.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That is confusing. The email said the refund was complete, so I thought my bank had lost it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I understand. The email wording should distinguish approval from payment settlement.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you give me a reference the bank can trace?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: There is no bank trace reference yet. I have opened synthetic billing case SYN-BILL-204 to check the processor queue.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Will I need to send the return receipt again?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No, it is attached to the case. Please allow another five business days; that is an estimate, not a confirmed payment date.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay, but I still need the money back. Please keep the case open until it actually arrives.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I will keep it open and post the settlement reference here when available. The refund is still pending today.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Why was my refund denied? The portable fan is unused and still in its box.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Synthetic order SYN-5207 arrived July 3. I submitted the return form yesterday.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The form was submitted after the thirty-day return window, which is why the request was denied.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Your colleague told me I had sixty days when I asked about it in July.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was that in a chat about this order, or a general question about returns?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: This order. I asked whether I could wait until after a trip to decide.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The saved reply says, "You have sixty days from delivery to return it." There was no mention of membership.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I found that earlier chat. The sixty-day allowance is for annual members; this order was placed on the standard plan.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I am on the standard plan, but nobody asked before giving me the longer deadline.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You are right that the reply did not explain the condition. I will escalate the conflicting advice for an exception review.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Does that mean the denial has been reversed?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Not yet. The original denial remains while a reviewer decides whether we can honor the quoted deadline.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please do not ship it back without a label. The review is expected within two business days, and the prior chat is attached.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Understood. I will wait, but I want the review to address the promise I was given, not just repeat the thirty-day rule.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please cancel my subscription. We barely used the reporting dashboard last month.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I tried the cancel button, but it kept sending me to a page offering a cheaper plan.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can help. Do you want to stop renewal, or close the workspace and remove access immediately?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Stop renewal. I still need to download the August reports.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: There is a lower-cost plan if you only need the exports. Would that help?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No thanks. I already decided to cancel; the extra offer screen was what confused me.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Understood. I have turned off renewal. Your subscription will end September 30, and access continues until then.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The dashboard should now show "Ends September 30" instead of the next renewal date.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It does. Will there be another charge? My card app already shows a payment from September 1.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That payment covers the current month. No further renewal charge will be made after this cancellation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: So cancelling today does not refund yesterday's payment?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Correct. This cancellation does not include a refund of the current month, and I have not submitted a refund request.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay. I have downloaded the reports now. I am glad it is cancelled, but the self-service flow took too much effort.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The cancellation is confirmed. I have also recorded your feedback about the repeated offer page.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I cannot finish setting up my account. The verification email never arrived.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The page says it sent one, but I have tried three times and am still stuck on "Check your inbox."

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please check spam and any filtered folders. Are you using the newest verification email if more than one arrived?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: There are none in spam either. This is a synthetic test account, setup-demo@example.invalid.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does that match the address shown on the setup screen? Please do not share a password or verification code.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Oh, the screen says setpu-demo@example.invalid. I swapped the letters when I entered it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That explains the missing message. Choose "Change email" below the resend button and correct the address.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I found it. That link is very faint; I had assumed I needed to start over.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I corrected it and requested another email. Now two messages have appeared in the synthetic mailbox.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Use the most recent one. Resending can invalidate the older link.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The first link said expired. The newer one worked, and I can sign in now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Great. Can you also reach the workspace screen, rather than just the sign-in page?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, the workspace is open. The invite teammate button is there too. Setup is finished.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I will close this as resolved and note that the email correction link and expired-link message need clearer wording.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My package says delivered, but nothing arrived. It is synthetic order SYN-6308, the replacement kettle.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I checked with my neighbours too. Nobody has it, and there was no card left.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier marked it delivered yesterday at 16:42. Have you checked any shared parcel shelf or reception area?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: There is a parcel shelf, and I checked it twice. Reception was closed at that time.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The delivery note says "left at front door." Is there a photo in the tracking page?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, but the photo shows a blue door. Our building entrance is green.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I cannot read a number in the picture, so I cannot tell which building it is.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That looks like a possible wrong-location delivery. I will open a carrier investigation rather than ask you to keep waiting for a normal delivery.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you send another kettle today? I have already waited a week.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I cannot confirm a replacement yet. The carrier needs to check its delivery record first; I expect an initial update within two business days.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Synthetic case SYN-SHIP-319 is open with the photo mismatch noted.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The automated email just says "Enjoy your order." That is pretty frustrating when I do not have it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I agree the delivered status is misleading here. I have recorded that feedback and kept the missing-package case open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay. Please update this chat when you hear back. I still need either the package or a clear replacement decision.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can I return an opened item? I bought a desk lamp, tried it once, and the light is too harsh.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Opened items cannot be returned.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The return policy on your website says opened items qualify within thirty days.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It says to include all accessories. I have the cable, base and original box, so which rule applies?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Let me check the product category and the current policy. Was it marked final sale when you ordered?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It was discounted, but the receipt does not say final sale. Synthetic order SYN-7410 arrived September 18.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You are right. My earlier explanation was incorrect; that restriction belongs to a different product category.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Opened desk lamps can be returned within thirty days unless marked final sale. A discount by itself does not make an item final sale.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thank you. The help widget also says the thirty days start at purchase, but this page says delivery.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: For this order the deadline is measured from delivery. The purchase-date wording in that widget is outdated.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: So I am still eligible today even though I placed the order earlier in September?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes. I have issued synthetic return authorization SYN-RET-118 and attached the label here. Pack the lamp and all accessories; the refund follows inspection.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I have the label now. I will send it tomorrow. I wish the website, widget and first answer had agreed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I have flagged both contradictory explanations for correction. The return is authorized, but the item has not been received and no refund has been paid yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The refund went to a card I replaced. Is it lost?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Replacing the plastic usually keeps the underlying account open. Did you close the account itself?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No, just replaced the card after it stopped working.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The reversal was accepted by the issuer yesterday. Ask them to check the old card number's account, without sharing the number here.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Found it. It was listed under adjustments, not recent purchases.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good, that confirms it reached you. I'll close the payment trace.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: You refunded one shirt, but I returned two in the same bag.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The green one is missing from the refund email.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The warehouse recorded only the striped shirt. Were both attached to the same return authorization?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I photographed both before sealing the bag.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please attach that photo with any address details covered. I'll request the receiving station's scan.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Uploaded. I don't want to be told to start another return for something you already have.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You won't need another shipment. The second refund remains disputed while we reconcile the contents.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The photo upload preview is sideways, but both shirts are visible.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can rotate it for the review. Is the return bag number visible in the handover receipt?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, it matches the bag number beside the striped shirt in your email.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That helps link the second item to the same receiving batch.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I also put the item list inside the bag. Would that be scanned?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Sometimes, but I won't assume it exists. I've asked for any enclosed paperwork as well as the receiving images.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please make sure the warehouse checks the green shirt specifically, not just the total bag weight.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The request identifies that missing item explicitly. The review has not returned a decision.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My return shows a full refund, but the amount is short by the outbound delivery fee.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The product amount was returned. Was the item faulty or did you change your mind?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Changed my mind.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I thought full refund meant everything.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: For this order, the standard delivery charge isn't reimbursed for a change-of-mind return. The email should make that distinction.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I see the breakdown now. I still think the original email was misleading.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll record the wording issue. The product refund is complete; I haven't approved a delivery-fee refund.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: What if the outbound service had been late? Would the delivery fee be handled differently?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That would need a separate review of the delivery promise and actual date.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It was on time in my case. I only wanted to understand the deduction.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then no late-delivery claim applies here. The explanation in the itemized breakdown is the one for this return.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The store credit option was selected accidentally. Can the refund go back to my original payment?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Have you spent any of the credit?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: None. It appeared ten minutes ago and I haven't placed another order.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can cancel the unused credit and reissue to the original card. This will start the card settlement wait again.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's fine. Please don't leave both balances active.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The credit is now zero and the card reversal is accepted.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The statement notification just arrived. Thank you for fixing the selection.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both records agree now; the duplicate credit has been removed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The bank wants a trace number for a refund you say was sent.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can see approval, but the settlement field is blank. What date did the approval email arrive?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: July 8. Every reply since then just says check with the bank.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then we shouldn't send you back to the bank yet. I need the payment operations team to confirm whether the transfer actually left us.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please put that distinction in the case. I have already called them twice.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Added. There is no trace number to give you today, and I will keep the case open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Should I ask the bank for a written response now?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Not yet. First we need to confirm whether a settlement was actually sent.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The last agent said it was definitely paid. Can that statement be corrected in the history?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've added a correction: approval exists, but payment settlement isn't confirmed. The older message remains visible as part of the record.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The refund is showing as two tiny amounts instead of one. That looks wrong.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Did the original purchase use a gift balance plus a card?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, I forgot about the gift balance. I used the last of it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The return reverses each payment source separately. The gift portion is back in your account and the remainder is on the card.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Ah, together they add up exactly. I was looking only at the card.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That accounts for the entire amount; neither portion is outstanding.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The replacement mixer arrived damaged too. I want my money back this time.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'm sorry the replacement failed as well. Is the cracked housing visible without turning it on?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I haven't plugged it in. Also the driver left it outside in the rain again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please leave it unplugged. I've approved a refund instead of another replacement and arranged collection.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you also stop using that delivery instruction? There isn't a sheltered porch here.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've removed the leave-outside preference for future orders. The carrier still needs to confirm the collection slot.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: So the refund is approved but not paid until you collect it?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Correct. Payment is pending return receipt; the delivery preference change is already saved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The refund link in the email opens somebody else's order number.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I closed it straight away.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please don't paste any details from that page. Does the email subject contain your own synthetic order reference?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, SYN-R812. I only want the correct refund status.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll disable that link and escalate the mismatch. Your return is received, but I can't verify the payment from that page.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I won't open it again. Please use this chat for updates.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Agreed. The link incident and pending refund check are open separately.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you send me a fresh link while the mismatch is investigated?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll use a verified account-status route after the link has been disabled. I don't want to send another unverified link.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can still access my own order history, which says processing.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That is consistent with the pending payment check, but isn't proof of settlement.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I thought the refund was missing, but now I see a credit dated before I even returned the item.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Some card statements display a reversal against the original purchase date. Does the credited amount match the returned item?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It does. The original purchase is crossed out and there's no new refund row.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That is how this issuer displays reversals. Your remaining order items are still charged normally.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay, the net total is right. I was searching the wrong week.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll mark the missing-refund inquiry resolved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Your return calculation deducts a bundle discount from the headset I kept. Why?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The original bundle discount required both items. Returning the stand recalculates the retained headset at its standalone price.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That wasn't on the return preview. It showed a larger amount.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I would have kept the stand if I'd known.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can see the preview discrepancy. I've requested review of that difference, rather than treating the recalculation as settled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Has any money actually been sent?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The undisputed portion has settled. The additional amount shown in the preview is still under review.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I paid in euros and the refund arrived in my card's home currency. The value is lower.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was the original charge converted by your issuer, or did you choose conversion at checkout?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The issuer converted it. I didn't select a currency option.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: We reversed the original euro amount. Exchange-rate differences may be applied by the issuer; I can provide the transaction amounts for comparison.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please do. The difference is larger than I expected.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've supplied both euro amounts. I can't confirm the issuer's rate or reimburse the difference without further review.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I accidentally requested the same refund twice. Now there are two cases and I'm worried they'll block each other.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Do both requests refer to the same returned bookshelf?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. The first page timed out, so I clicked submit again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The payment record has one reversal. I've linked the duplicate case and closed only the extra request.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My balance shows the refund now. Please leave that one alone.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. The settled reversal remains; the duplicate case won't initiate another payment.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The workshop was cancelled, but only one of our two seats was refunded.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Were both seats purchased in one checkout?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. We also need to cancel the recurring workshop pass. It keeps trying to renew.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I found the second seat attached to a guest booking. I've submitted its refund and stopped renewal of the pass.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Will cancelling the pass erase the receipts for the workshop?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No, those receipts remain available. The first seat is settled; the second payment hasn't settled yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: At least the renewal is stopped.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'll check the second refund tomorrow.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The pass now shows no next renewal date. I'll keep the seat-refund case open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My refund request keeps disappearing when I upload the receipt.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It's a PDF, not a photo, and the page goes back to step one.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the upload larger than the displayed limit?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No. It's well below it. I can upload it to this chat instead.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please do, with any personal details covered. I'll register the request manually and attach the receipt.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Sent. Can you tell me whether this means the refund is accepted?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It means the request is received. Eligibility and payment still need review; the upload failure has been logged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Does the manual request keep today's date or the date of my first failed attempt?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've recorded both the first reported attempt and today's manual registration for the reviewer.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The first attempt was before the deadline. The screenshot has the time on it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've attached that screenshot so the eligibility review can account for the failed submission.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The account wallet shows a refund, but I chose bank transfer. Can you check?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That wallet row is a status record, not spendable credit. Does it have a withdrawal button?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No, it just says completed. I thought I needed to cash it out.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The transfer was sent to the verified account already on file. There is nothing to withdraw here.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I checked the account and it's there under the payment partner's name.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That confirms receipt. I'll flag the wallet wording for clarification.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: You refunded the damaged printer, but I can't download the purchase invoice anymore.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Are you opening it from the order history or the return email?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Order history. Since the refund it says document unavailable. Our bookkeeper needs both invoice and credit note.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've restored access to the invoice and supplied the credit note separately.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The credit note opens, but the invoice download is still blank on my tablet.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It works in the browser check here. I've raised the tablet download problem; the refund itself is fully settled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'll use the desktop file for now. Please keep the tablet issue open.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Done. The payment case is resolved; document access on the tablet remains under investigation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The refund is marked rejected because the name on the payout doesn't match. This was a gift purchase.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Did you request payment to a different account from the one that paid?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, to the recipient. I thought they'd get the refund since they returned it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: We can't redirect it that way. I can request reversal to the original payment source after checking the failed payout.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please do that. The recipient doesn't need to receive it directly.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The failed transfer needs to be reconciled first. I've queued that check; no replacement payment is confirmed yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The return was approved, then the refund vanished from the activity page.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was this a payment still pending when the order was cancelled?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. It never reached the posted transactions list.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: This was an authorization release rather than a credit. The reserved amount should disappear instead of appearing as money returned.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The available balance has gone back up.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That was what I needed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then the authorization release is complete. No separate credit is expected.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Cancel the meal plan before next week. I'm away for a month.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Would you like a temporary pause or an end to the recurring plan?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: An end. I might subscribe again later, but don't restart it automatically.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Renewal is disabled. This week's already prepared box remains scheduled; there are no future boxes after it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That works. I can see next week has disappeared from the calendar.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed, the plan is cancelled with no automatic restart.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I cancelled the box subscription yesterday and still got charged today.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The next box entered packing before yesterday's cancellation. Was the cutoff warning shown when you cancelled?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No. Also the address is outdated, so sending it isn't useful.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll ask dispatch to stop the packed box and review the charge. Renewal is already off.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you change the address if they can't stop it?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've passed the corrected synthetic destination through the secure order form. Dispatch has not confirmed either change.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: So the subscription is over, but the last box is still a problem.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Exactly. Cancellation is confirmed; shipment and charge review remain open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Stop my premium plan. I only need the free account now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can stop renewal without deleting your account. Do you need access to saved projects afterwards?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. Please don't delete them.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The account will move to the free plan at the end of the paid period. Projects over the free limit become read-only.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Read-only is fine. I only need to view them.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Renewal is off and your projects are retained.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The cancellation button is missing. I'm the person who pays the bill.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does your account show owner or member in workspace settings?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Member. The owner left our team last month.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Billing access alone doesn't grant ownership. We need an ownership-transfer check before changing the subscription.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That seems like a trap when the owner has gone.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've opened the transfer review and noted the upcoming renewal. I haven't cancelled the plan yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please make sure the reviewer sees the renewal deadline.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Added to the case. Approval is still outstanding.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can a second administrator authorize the change?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: An administrator can help supply workspace records, but subscription ownership still needs verification.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We have the previous invoices and the former owner's handover note.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Submit those through the ownership review form, with personal details covered. I've linked the form to this case.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Submitted. The confirmation gives a review reference.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I see it. That documents the request, not approval to change ownership or billing yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Cancel my annual plan today.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I thought it was monthly.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can stop next year's renewal. The current annual term was paid at checkout; stopping renewal won't shorten that term automatically.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I want the account stopped now, not another year of access.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Immediate closure is possible, but the unused-term adjustment requires review. Would you like to keep export access during that review?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I need the files before closing anything.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Renewal is off. Access remains for export while the unused-term request is reviewed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Fine. That's not the immediate cancellation I expected, but it avoids losing my work.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Will the export contain comments as well as files? Our project decisions are in those comments.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Choose the full workspace archive rather than files only. It includes the available comment history.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I started that archive and it says it will notify me when ready.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please verify the archive before requesting immediate closure. Renewal remains off meanwhile.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I keep receiving upgrade reminders after cancelling. Did the cancellation fail?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The subscription is cancelled. Are those promotional emails or payment reminders?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Promotional. They say come back before the offer expires.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've turned off promotional messages. Your cancellation record hasn't changed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Great. I was reading them as a warning that I'd still be billed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: There is no scheduled renewal; the marketing preference is now off too.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Is there still a login if I need the old invoices?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes. Stopping the subscription and marketing messages doesn't delete the account.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I opened an old invoice successfully. That's all I need from it now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good. The account retains invoice access without scheduled renewal.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My plan is cancelled in the app but active on the website.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I don't know which status to trust.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Did you subscribe through the app store or directly through our checkout?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Through the app store. The store says expired yesterday.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The entitlement sync hasn't updated our site. I'll reconcile it with the store receipt; please use the secure upload rather than sharing payment details.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Uploaded. I don't want another renewal.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The store controls renewal, and its expired status is useful evidence. Our site status correction is still pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Should I reinstall the app to force the update?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Reinstalling won't fix the website entitlement record. You can avoid that extra step.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Good. The old agent had me sign out on every device and it made no difference.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've added that failed troubleshooting so the next reviewer doesn't ask you to repeat it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please cancel only the second workspace. Keep the first one active.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I see a trial workspace and a paid workspace. Which one should stop?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The trial called Practice Lab. The paid one is still needed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The Practice Lab trial is closed and has no scheduled conversion. The paid workspace is unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Perfect. I was scared the button would cancel both.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The two subscriptions are separate, and only the trial was closed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'm leaving because the export job fails every Friday. Please cancel renewal.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can do that. Do you need one final export before the paid period ends?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, the last report is still stuck. A discount won't help if I can't get my data.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Renewal is now disabled. I've also sent the stuck export to the reporting team for recovery.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: They suggested reducing the date range last time. That lost half the report.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've included that failed workaround so they don't repeat it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thanks. Please leave access open until I can download the complete file.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Access remains through the paid period. An extension needs approval; export recovery is still open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I signed up for two trials by mistake.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Cancel the one that ends tomorrow.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both trials have different end dates. Can you identify the workspace name, without account credentials?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Draft Studio is the one ending tomorrow. Keep Sample Studio until next week.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Draft Studio's conversion is disabled. Sample Studio is unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can see that now. Thank you.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No charge is scheduled for Draft Studio.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I asked to cancel on the phone, but the chat page still says renewing.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Do you have a case reference from that call?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only synthetic case SYN-CALL-88. They said it was done.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The call note says cancellation requested, but the final confirmation step wasn't recorded.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I explicitly said yes. I don't want to go through it again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've escalated the mismatch and flagged the deadline. The renewal hasn't been disabled yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Cancel my photo backup plan. I have moved everything to another service.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Before I close it, have you downloaded the original files rather than the preview copies?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I didn't realize those were different. The downloaded images look small.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Use Export originals under storage settings. I can disable renewal now while you download those files.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please do. The original export has started and the file sizes look right.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Renewal is disabled, and the export remains available during your current term.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The archive finished and opens correctly. You can leave the cancellation in place.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. The originals are exported and no renewal is scheduled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Turn off my membership, but keep the dependent account working.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The dependent account uses your membership entitlement. It can't remain on that entitlement once the term ends.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The cancellation screen doesn't say that. I thought only my own access stopped.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can stop renewal now and give you the date when both accounts lose paid access. A separate plan would be needed for the dependent account.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Stop renewal anyway. I need time to decide about the other plan.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Done. Both retain access through the current term; no replacement plan has been purchased.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please cancel the add-on seats, not the main plan.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: How many unused seats should be removed at renewal?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Three. We still need the two active users.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've scheduled the seat count to drop from five to two at renewal. The base plan stays active.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's the exact change I wanted. The old page only had a big cancel subscription button.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The upcoming invoice preview now shows two seats.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The cancel page won't load after I enter the confirmation word.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I tried the mobile browser and desktop.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Both spin forever.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll check whether either request reached the service. Are you seeing any cancellation email?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No email. I have a screenshot of the spinner, nothing else.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No completed request is recorded. I've opened a manual cancellation case with your request time.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't call the spinner a successful cancellation.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Agreed. It remains active until the manual change is confirmed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It worked in a private window until the final confirmation, then froze again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That narrows it to the submission step rather than just saved browser state.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The button became disabled, so I couldn't tell whether it had sent anything.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've recorded the disabled-button behavior and both browser attempts.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Would it help to have the approximate times?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes, the times shown in your screenshots can help trace requests. Please cover any account identifiers.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Uploaded two screenshots. The timestamps are six minutes apart.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both are attached to the manual request. Neither proves a completed cancellation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Is it cancelled or paused? The banner says see you soon.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The billing record says cancelled. A pause would include a restart date; yours has none.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's reassuring. The banner made me think it would resume next month.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've sent the confirmation showing renewal disabled and no restart date.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Got it. I don't need anything else.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll close this status clarification.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Cancel my learning plan. The course says captions exist, but several lessons have none.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll disable renewal. Can you identify one affected lesson so the accessibility team can investigate?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Lesson four, the budget worksheet demo. I can't follow the audio reliably.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Renewal is off. I've requested a transcript for that lesson and reported the missing captions.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I would like to finish it before access ends, if the transcript arrives.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The transcript is not ready yet. I'll keep that request open while the cancellation stays in place.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please withdraw my cancellation. I chose the wrong workspace.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The paid term hasn't ended yet, so renewal can be restored. Do you want the current plan and seat count unchanged?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. Then cancel the empty test workspace separately.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The current workspace is restored, and the empty trial's conversion is disabled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Both status pages now look right.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. The paid workspace will renew; the empty trial will not.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I sold the device and need its monitoring subscription cancelled.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the device already transferred out of your account?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The transfer is pending. The buyer hasn't accepted the invite yet.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Cancelling monitoring during transfer needs a manual check so we don't remove the buyer's pending entitlement.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I don't want to pay while the buyer decides.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've noted that concern and submitted the request. Cancellation is not confirmed yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The invitation opens an empty workspace instead of the one my teammate invited me to.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Are you already signed into another account in that browser?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, my old trial.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I didn't notice it was still logged in.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Sign out and reopen the invitation. That should use the invited account rather than create another workspace.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That worked. I can see the shared project now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The invitation is accepted in the right workspace. No new subscription was created.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The setup wizard refuses our company name because it contains an ampersand.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I don't want to enter a false name just to get through.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does the error appear while typing or after pressing continue?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only after continue. The field turns red with no explanation.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've reproduced the validation failure and sent it to the setup team. Please keep the draft saved rather than changing the legal name.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Saved, but we still can't complete setup.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Correct. I don't have a confirmed fix date yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Does leaving the draft block invitations to other people?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Invitations aren't enabled until this setup step completes, so the team is blocked too.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We have a launch rehearsal tomorrow. Is there a safe temporary workaround?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I don't have one verified. I've noted the rehearsal date and requested a priority review.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can't scan the authenticator square. The phone camera is broken.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: There is a manual setup key underneath the square. Can your authenticator accept a key entered by hand?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I hadn't noticed the link to show it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Enter it locally and confirm the generated code on the setup page. Please don't send the key or code in chat.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Done. The next page shows recovery codes.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Save those securely outside this chat. Your authenticator enrollment is complete.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The trial is asking for a card before I've even added my team. I thought no card was needed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Which option did you choose on the welcome screen?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Annual plan. It looked like the default. I only wanted to try importing a spreadsheet.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've switched this workspace to the no-card trial. The payment step is no longer required.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Good. The spreadsheet import now says unknown column format though.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Can you download the sample and compare the date column format?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The dates match. It still fails at row eight.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Setup can proceed without the import. I've opened an import-format case; your trial has no scheduled charge.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Our single sign-on login loops between the identity page and your welcome page.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does ordinary email login work, or is the workspace restricted to single sign-on?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Restricted. The administrator tested the connection and got a green tick.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The test connection may succeed even if the callback setting differs. Please ask the administrator to check the callback shown in our setup guide.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: They checked it. It matches exactly.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll request the failed login event through the admin console. We shouldn't disable the restriction as a blind workaround.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thank you. We need a fix before we can onboard anyone.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The login investigation remains open; no access has been restored yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The administrator found a failed event saying missing audience.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please attach the event through the admin diagnostics form; don't paste tokens from it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Attached. It happens only for newly invited accounts, not existing members.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That's important. I've narrowed the case to new-member provisioning rather than all workspace login.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can we invite fewer people while it's investigated?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Inviting again may create more pending records. Please wait for the provisioning check.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The language selector switched the whole wizard to Spanish and I can't find how to undo it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The globe icon in the upper-right opens language choices. Is it visible on your screen?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Not on the narrow phone view.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Open the menu first; the globe is inside it on that layout.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Found it. English is restored and I finished the welcome steps.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll note that the language control is hard to locate on mobile.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I accepted the invitation, but the project list is empty.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your account exists. Have you been assigned a project, or only added to the workspace?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only added to the workspace apparently. The invitation said start collaborating, so I expected the files.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: A workspace admin needs to assign project access. I've sent them the access request through the workspace notification.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: One project appeared, but the other is still missing.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Account setup is complete; access to the second project is still awaiting the admin's approval.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We can't finish setup because the starter kit hasn't arrived. The wizard asks for its activation code.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That code is printed on the kit, but you can create the account before activating the hardware.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The delivery page says tomorrow. Can I at least invite staff today?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Choose skip hardware activation. Staff invites don't require the kit code.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The skip link worked and two invites have been sent.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good. I've also checked that the kit is still in transit, not marked delivered.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Then the account is ready, and we'll activate the kit when it comes.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Exactly. No refund request or replacement shipment is needed at this stage.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The verification call never reaches the extension on our office line.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The automated call can't navigate extensions. Is another supported verification method shown?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only SMS, which that line can't receive. We need the office account, not someone's personal phone.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested review for an alternative verification route. Please don't invent a phone number to pass the step.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay. Leave the draft in place.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Saved. Verification remains incomplete.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can the administrator approve the account from their console instead?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Their approval covers workspace membership, not this required verification step.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Then please make that clear in the review. We already have membership approval.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Included. The missing verification route is the remaining blocker, not a lack of invitation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The invite says expired, but my teammate sent it a minute ago.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Could your mail app be opening an earlier invitation from the same thread?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It groups them all together. Yes, I clicked the oldest message.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Open the latest message's link, not the thread's preview button.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Now I'm in. The preview kept choosing the old link.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll note that behavior. Your workspace membership is active.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Should I delete the old invite messages so this doesn't happen again?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You can archive them, but the accepted membership no longer needs any invitation link.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The workspace bookmark opens directly now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That's the simplest route for future sign-ins; the invite has already done its job.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I finished signup but the checkout insists I need a second account to pay.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You shouldn't. Are the workspace and checkout using different sign-in addresses?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The workspace uses a synthetic alias, team-test@example.invalid.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Checkout says I'm a guest.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Sign into checkout with the same account rather than submitting another order.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That fixed the account mismatch, but the bank verification screen won't close.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Account setup is complete. I've opened a payment-authentication check; don't repeat checkout until we confirm whether a charge exists.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Agreed. I don't want two charges while trying to get started.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The billing check remains pending. No completed purchase is confirmed here.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The timezone list has two cities with the same offset. Which one should I choose for scheduled reports?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Choose the timezone whose daylight-saving rules match your location, not just today's offset.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The test workspace runs on UTC all year. We don't want seasonal changes.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Select UTC. The preview should keep the scheduled hour unchanged across the year.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The preview looks right now. Setup is complete.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed; this workspace's schedule uses UTC.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The profile photo crop hides the continue button with keyboard navigation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can focus the crop controls but can't leave that panel.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does escape close it, or does focus remain trapped?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Escape does nothing. I don't use a mouse.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've reported the keyboard trap. You can omit the photo during signup, but that doesn't fix the inaccessible panel itself.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I refreshed and skipped it. The account works, but the photo step is still unusable.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll keep the accessibility defect open; the skipped step isn't a resolution of that defect.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you include the keyboard sequence I used? Tab reaches rotate and then loops back to zoom.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes. I've recorded that sequence and the escape behavior.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The screen reader announces the continue button but I never reach it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That distinction is useful; the control exists in the accessibility tree but isn't reachable by keyboard.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'm stuck choosing a role. I manage the workspace but don't write code.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The role question personalizes the welcome checklist; it doesn't restrict your permissions. What tasks do you need first?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Invite staff and check usage. The developer option sounded wrong.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Choose operations. You can still use the admin tools assigned to your account.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's clearer. I picked operations and the checklist makes sense now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your setup is finished, and permissions are unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The welcome page says connect a bank account. I only need the invoicing demo.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The bank connection is optional for creating draft invoices. You can skip it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I skipped it, but now an old trial invoice has a pay button. Please don't charge anything while I'm learning.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Draft invoices don't charge your card. That pay button opens a payment page for the invoice recipient.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can we remove it from the demo so my colleagues don't use it by mistake?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've marked the sample invoice void. A separate display issue still leaves the stale button visible until the page refreshes.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Refreshed. The demo is usable now, but that distinction wasn't obvious.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Setup is complete. I'll keep the confusing sample-invoice presentation on the product feedback list.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I entered the workspace name with a typo.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Is that permanent after signup?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The display name is editable in settings. The workspace identifier is separate and won't change.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I only want the display name corrected, not a new workspace.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You can edit that safely. Check the invite preview after saving.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Saved. The invite now has the correct fictional name, Sample Orchard.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good; your existing members and projects stay in the same workspace.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The account says it already exists, but password reset says no account found.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Did you originally sign up with a provider button rather than a password?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I may have used it once. The provider button now gives an error too.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll have the identity team check whether a partial signup is blocking both routes. Please don't create another account with variations of the address.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'd rather wait than split the workspace history.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The identity review is open. No reset or account merge has been completed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The welcome tutorial keeps starting again every time I open the app.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does the last tutorial page have a finish button you haven't been able to reach?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It did, but I always closed the window after the last animation.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Use finish once so the completion state is saved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Done. I reopened the app and it stayed on the dashboard.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The tutorial completion is now recorded. No account or payment changes were involved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I imported my contacts during setup and every row appears twice.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was the file submitted twice after a slow response?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. There was no progress indicator, so I thought the first attempt failed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've removed the second import batch while keeping the first. Please check a few rows.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The duplicates are gone, but the notes column is empty in both batches.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Duplicate cleanup is complete. The missing notes need a mapping review, so I'll keep that part open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The tracking has said label created for four days. Has anyone actually handed over the parcel?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: There is no carrier acceptance scan yet. What was the promised dispatch date?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Last Monday. The order page calls it shipped, which doesn't match the tracking.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll ask the warehouse to locate the parcel. A label alone doesn't confirm handover.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't just send the same tracking link again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Understood. The warehouse trace is open; dispatch is not confirmed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The warehouse reply yesterday just said dispatched. Does that mean physically handed over?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Not necessarily in this status system. I'll ask for the handover scan or collection manifest specifically.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's the evidence I need. I won't wait another week on a label.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your concern is recorded. We still need that evidence before calling it shipped.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Tracking says delivery attempted, but I was home and heard no knock.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is there an access instruction that could have sent the driver to the wrong entrance?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The old side entrance is still listed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That gate is locked now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've changed the instruction to the main entrance and booked another attempt tomorrow.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The courier just delivered it at the main entrance. Everything is intact.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll close the delivery case and keep the corrected instruction.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: One parcel arrived, but the invoice lists three items and only two were inside.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: This order has two shipments. The third item is in a separate parcel due tomorrow.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The packing note didn't say that. Also I was charged delivery twice.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll send both tracking references and have billing check the duplicated delivery fee.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The second parcel is moving, so that part makes sense now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The split shipment is explained; the second delivery charge remains under review.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please keep the fee case open. I didn't choose two paid deliveries.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Added. There is no approved fee reversal yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The parcel locker won't open even though the code is accepted.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does the screen identify a compartment and then show a mechanical error?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, compartment twelve. I can hear a click but the door stays shut.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Don't force it. I've contacted the locker operator for a remote retry.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: They called the locker and it opened this time. I have the parcel.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good. The collection is confirmed; the locker fault is recorded with its operator.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The screen still shows my parcel as ready even though I took it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Locker collection status can take a few minutes to sync. Has the door been closed?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, and the operator's confirmation just changed it to collected.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The operator and our tracking now agree. You don't need to enter the code again.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My tracking changed to return to sender. I haven't refused anything.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier note says incomplete address. Is the apartment field present on the order confirmation?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I checked the confirmation, and the apartment is there.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then the label may have omitted it. I'll ask for the label copy and see whether the carrier can intercept the return.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I still want the order delivered, not cancelled.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've recorded that preference. Interception isn't confirmed yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Is there any way to inspect the address on the actual label?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested the label image from shipping, with irrelevant personal details redacted.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The apartment field appears on my order PDF but is blank in the packing preview.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That gives us a possible point where it was lost. I've added both documents to the investigation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Would a new order avoid the issue?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Don't place another yet. We need to know whether this parcel can be redirected and whether the label defect would recur.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The parcel arrived with a crushed corner. The lamp works, but the shade is bent.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the base stable and the cable undamaged? Please stop using it if there is any electrical damage.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Cable and base look fine. It's just the shade.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: We can send a replacement shade rather than replace the whole lamp. I've requested the part stock check.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That would be better than packing everything again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The damage claim is accepted, but the part's dispatch date is not confirmed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you redirect today's delivery? The subscription still uses the old pickup location.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can request a carrier redirect, and separately update future subscription deliveries. Is the new pickup location supported?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It's another listed collection point.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I selected it in the secure form.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier accepted the redirect. I've also saved it for future subscription boxes.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can see the new point in tracking and next month's preview.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both changes are confirmed; the subscription itself remains active.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The parcel is stuck at customs and the carrier asks for a product description.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The commercial invoice should already include one. Is the request for clarification or for a missing document?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It says missing item description, not a tax payment request.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll ask shipping to resend the commercial invoice with the specific description. Don't pay anything based on an unrelated message.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I only contacted you through the tracking page. I'll wait for the corrected document.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The document request is submitted. Customs release is still pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The delivery map shows a town we've never lived in. Is my order going there?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Can you compare the destination shown on the order confirmation with the carrier's text status?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The confirmation is correct. The text says local depot; only the map pin is wrong.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier has confirmed the destination record is correct. The depot map pin is a display error.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The package just arrived at our collection point. No refund needed; I only wanted to check the route.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Delivery is confirmed, and the incorrect map pin has been reported.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The setup device arrived without its power adapter. I can't activate it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does the packing list include the adapter as a separate box?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No, it says included. The activation screen keeps asking me to power on the device.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested the missing adapter shipment. You can complete account signup now, but hardware activation must wait.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Signup is done. Please don't mark the device setup complete.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I won't. Account signup is complete; the adapter and hardware activation remain pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The driver left a large parcel at the curb. I ordered indoor delivery because I can't carry it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The order does include indoor delivery. Is the parcel still outside and unopened?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I can't move it safely.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested an urgent carrier return visit and noted the service mismatch. Please don't try to lift it yourself.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thank you. I need an actual collection time.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier hasn't confirmed a time yet. I'll keep this open until that is arranged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Rain is forecast tonight. Could the packaging get damaged if it stays there?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That increases urgency. I've updated the carrier request with the weather concern, but I can't guarantee their arrival time.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can cover it with a sheet without lifting it. Is that okay?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: If you can do so safely, that may help protect the carton. Please don't risk injury to move it indoors.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The delivery slot moved to the evening, but nobody asked whether that works for us.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier changed the route. Would a pickup point be preferable to another home slot?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, the listed station locker would let me collect tomorrow.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've converted it to locker pickup and the carrier accepted the change.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I received the collection notice and picked it up.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Much easier.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll close the case and note the unannounced slot change.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Tracking says delivered to reception. Our reception has no record of it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We checked the log and the storage cupboard.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll request the delivery signature. Do you recognize the initials shown in the tracking?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No. They aren't anyone on our staff.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier confirms it went to a neighboring office. They've agreed to retrieve it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's progress, but we still don't have the parcel.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Correct. The wrong location is confirmed; redelivery is still outstanding.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The order is ready for pickup, but the store says they can't find the code.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the code for the order or the separate store membership?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I showed the membership QR. There is another barcode in the collection email.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Use the collection barcode. It identifies this specific parcel.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: They found it immediately with that one. I have it now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Collection is complete. I'll note that the two codes need clearer labels.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I need the shipment stopped. The cancellation request was approved, but the tracking just started moving.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The warehouse stop and carrier handover appear to have crossed. I'll request a carrier intercept.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: If it can't be stopped, am I supposed to refuse delivery or return it?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please wait for the intercept result. If it arrives first, keep it unopened and contact us; I won't assume refusal is possible.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: And is my cancellation still recorded?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes, the cancellation request is recorded. The shipment intercept and payment adjustment are not completed yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please keep all of that on one case so I don't explain it again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Linked. We still need confirmation from dispatch and billing.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The parcel contains the right parts, but the packing slip belongs to a different synthetic order.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please avoid sharing anything from that slip. Are your own items and quantities correct?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. It only has fictional order references, but I still want the paperwork fixed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've supplied the correct packing slip and asked the warehouse to review the document mix-up.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The replacement slip matches everything. I don't need a return or refund.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your order documentation is corrected; the warehouse process issue is recorded separately.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Two cartons should have arrived together.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The second one has the table legs, so I can't assemble anything.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The carrier scanned one carton as delivered and the other at the depot. I'll request a paired-carton check.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The tracking email didn't distinguish them. It said the whole order was delivered.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've sent the two carton references separately. The depot located the missing carton but hasn't loaded it for delivery.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: At least it's found. Please don't close this until both are here.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Agreed. Location is confirmed; delivery of the second carton remains pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can they deliver only the missing carton without asking me to return the first?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes, the located carton is the missing part of this order. The first carton should stay with you.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'll keep the packaging until we know everything is complete.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That is sensible. I've asked the carrier to confirm the carton count at redelivery.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The carrier says my parcel was damaged and won't deliver it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The damage scan happened before delivery. Would you prefer a replacement shipment or cancellation?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Replacement. I still need the shelf, and there's no deadline.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: A replacement has been dispatched. You don't need to return the damaged parcel; it's still with the carrier.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The replacement arrived today and the pieces are all there.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll mark the delivery issue resolved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I chose a collection point, but the notification says home delivery. I won't be there.

entries.speaker: agent
