entries.text: The checkout record shows collection point. I'll check whether the carrier mapping changed it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't leave it outside. I specifically avoided home delivery.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested a hold at the depot while the destination is corrected.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Is the hold active now?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It hasn't been acknowledged yet. I can't promise today's delivery attempt has been stopped.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Your return checker says my opened speaker is ineligible, but the product page says try it for thirty days.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Opened electronics are excluded from returns.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's exactly the opposite of the product page.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I didn't damage it. I used it for an afternoon and the bass rattles even at low volume.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Let me check this model rather than give you a category-wide answer. Was it marked final sale?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No. It was on an ordinary promotion, not final sale.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: You're right. This model has a thirty-day trial return. My first answer was too broad.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The rattle may also qualify as a fault, which is a separate assessment from a change-of-mind return.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Do I need to prove a fault to use the trial? I don't want to record a video just to send it back.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No, the trial return doesn't require proof of a fault. You can select sound quality didn't meet expectations.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The form still offers only unopened or defective. Neither describes this very well.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll issue the authorization manually so the missing form option doesn't block you.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thank you. Which date starts the thirty days, the order date or delivery?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Delivery for this trial. I can see it arrived on the fifth.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Good. The order was placed the previous month, so the checker may be using that instead.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That would explain the mismatch. I've reported the date calculation for investigation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Does the original box have to be pristine? The tape tore a bit when I opened it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Normal opening marks are acceptable for the trial. Include the speaker, cable and adapter and pack them securely.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I have all three. The return label has a different warehouse name from the original parcel.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That's the returns facility, so the label destination is correct. Don't reuse the outbound label.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Understood. I have printed the new one and will hand it over tomorrow.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The return is authorized. A refund isn't paid until the returned item is processed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Fine. Please keep the checker bug open even though you got me a label.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I will. Your authorization is complete; the automated eligibility error is still unresolved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can I return just the lid from a saucepan set? The rest is useful.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was the lid sold separately or only as part of the set?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only as part of the set. It doesn't fit my other pan.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: A change-of-mind return would need the complete set. We can't split that purchase into a lid-only return.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Then I'll keep it. I wasn't reporting a defect; I just misunderstood the size.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Understood. No return has been opened, and I've sent the dimensions for reference.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The return label expired while I was waiting for your reply about packaging.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the item still inside the original return window, or did the authorization reserve the deadline?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The window ended yesterday.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I asked the packaging question a week ago.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll request an extension based on the unanswered case. I can't simply tell you to create a new request after the deadline.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please keep the original request date attached.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Attached. A replacement label is not approved yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I still have the unanswered packaging message in the same thread.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can see its timestamp. I've included it as the reason for the extension request.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Does waiting for that decision affect the item inspection afterwards?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The inspection is separate. An extension decision would address handover timing, not guarantee a refund regardless of condition.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The boots don't fit. Can I exchange them and cancel the shoe-care subscription that came with checkout?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can handle those separately. Were the boots only tried indoors?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, still clean. The subscription was an accidental checkbox.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've approved the size exchange and disabled the subscription before its first renewal.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Great. Is the exchange a refund followed by a new purchase?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No, this size exchange uses the original order. The label is ready and the subscription has no scheduled renewal.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That is clearer. I'll use the exchange label.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both requests are confirmed; no refund transaction was initiated.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The site says final sale, but my receipt doesn't. Which one governs the jacket I bought last month?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The current product page may have changed since your purchase. I'll check the offer captured on the order.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The confirmation screenshot says standard returns. I saved it because the page was confusing.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The order record agrees with your screenshot. I've authorized the return under those purchase terms.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The form is still rejecting it as final sale though.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Use the manual label I've attached. The label is valid; the form's historical-policy handling still needs correction.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I opened the skincare kit but haven't used any products. Can it go back?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the hygiene seal on each product intact, or was only the outer box opened?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only the cardboard outer box. Each bottle's seal is intact.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The unopened hygiene seals meet this kit's return condition. The outer box being opened doesn't by itself exclude it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's all I needed. The generic unopened-items wording made it sound impossible.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've issued the return label and noted the ambiguous wording.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I sent the coat back, and inspection says stained. It wasn't stained when I packed it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I took a photo before sealing the bag.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please attach that photo. I'll request the receiving photos so we can compare rather than repeat the rejection.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Uploaded. The stain in your photo is on the lining, which I also photographed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've sent both images for a second inspection review. Don't submit a new return request.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Will the original one stay open?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes. The condition dispute and any refund remain undecided.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The photo also shows the lining label, so you can tell it is the same coat.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've pointed that out to the second reviewer.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Could the stain have happened during receiving? The outer bag looked torn in your photo.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It's possible, but I can't conclude that from the image. I've asked for the packaging condition note.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't erase the first rejection. I need to understand what changed if it's overturned.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The original decision will remain in the history alongside any later correction.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can I return a digital download if I haven't opened the file?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Did you download it already, or is the link still unused?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Unused. I bought the wrong edition and noticed before clicking.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: This order permits cancellation while the link is unused. I've disabled the link and approved the cancellation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The page now shows cancelled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I don't need the other edition today.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. The unused download won't be accessible anymore.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Will the disabled link still count as a download in your history?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No, the access log shows unused, and I've recorded the cancellation against that state.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The email still has a download button, but it opens a cancelled-order notice.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That's expected; the old email can't be edited, but the link no longer grants access.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The wrong monitor arrived. I need to return it, and the invoice has the wrong model too.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does the shipping carton show a different model from your order confirmation?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. The confirmation is right; the carton and invoice both show the smaller one.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've authorized a wrong-item return with no return shipping charge. Billing needs to correct the invoice separately.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I have the label. Can I use the old invoice in our accounts for now?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please wait for the corrected invoice. The return is authorized, but the document correction is still pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay. I'd rather not create another accounting mistake.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both requests are linked to the same synthetic order.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The label says return by today. The pickup appointment you offered is tomorrow.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The return-by date refers to booking handover. Your pickup was booked within the deadline, so tomorrow's scheduled collection is valid.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I have the booking confirmation from yesterday. Do I need another label?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No. The existing label remains valid for that collection.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The driver collected it this morning and scanned it successfully.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The handover is recorded. No deadline exception is needed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can I return the chair without the enormous box? The policy doesn't mention keeping it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It needs safe packaging for collection, but I'll check whether a packaging service is available for this item.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can't buy another box that size locally. Please don't tell me to use a thin bag.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Agreed. I've asked the bulky-returns team about reusable collection packaging.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I still want to return it; the seat height is wrong for me.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The request date is recorded, but suitable collection packaging isn't arranged yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I'd like to return the starter hub and unlink it from the account. The app won't let me remove it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: We need to remove its activation binding before it goes back. Is it still online?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I can disconnect it after you finish.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've released the binding and authorized the hardware return.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The device disappeared from the app. Will my account be deleted too?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No, the account remains. Only this device is unlinked.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Good. I have the return label and the account still opens.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both steps are complete; please factory-reset the hub locally before packing it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The website says exchanges are free, but the label page wants a shipping fee.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is this an exchange for the same product's size, or for a different product?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Same trousers, one size larger.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I didn't change the color or style.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then the fee is incorrect. I've generated a no-charge exchange label.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That fixes mine. The website still asks for the fee if I start again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The manual label is valid; I've kept the pricing defect open for the checkout team.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The replacement size is showing low stock. Does using the manual label reserve it?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: This authorization reserves the listed size for the exchange, but please check the confirmation reference.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The confirmation says reserved. I have handed over the parcel now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The handover scan is visible and the reservation remains attached to it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Is the thirty-day return deadline thirty calendar days or thirty working days?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: For this purchase it is thirty calendar days from delivery.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thanks. I'm on day twenty-eight and the next pickup is day thirty-one.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Booking the return within the window preserves this scheduled pickup. I've registered it today.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The confirmation includes today's request date and the pickup date. That's clear.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your return booking is complete.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I need to send back the spare battery, but tracking says it hasn't arrived. I actually received it yesterday.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The delivery status needs correction before the automatic return flow will open. Is the battery undamaged?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, unopened. It's the wrong capacity, and I'm worried about mailing a battery without the right packaging instructions.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Don't use a generic postal label. I've asked the regulated-returns team for the approved method and shipping has the scan mismatch.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't make me wait past the return deadline while the tracking catches up.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your request date is recorded. The carrier-approved return method and delivery-status correction are both outstanding.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can a gift be exchanged without telling the purchaser the price?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: A gift exchange can use a gift receipt without displaying the purchase price. Do you have that receipt?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, the synthetic gift reference is on it. I just need a different color.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've generated the gift exchange instructions. They show the item and exchange reference, not the amount.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That's perfect. I don't need a refund.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The exchange is authorized against the gift receipt.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Your agent said I could return the engraved bottle. The form says personalized items are excluded.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was the engraving incorrect or did you change your mind about the bottle?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Changed my mind. The engraving is exactly what I requested.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The standard policy excludes change-of-mind returns for correct personalization. I'll review the earlier promise rather than ignore it.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The chat explicitly said personalization wasn't a problem.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've attached that promise to an exception request. Standard eligibility is clarified; the exception is not decided.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I want to return a replacement part you sent free of charge.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It's the wrong connector.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Since it was a warranty shipment, use the warranty return reference, not a purchase refund form.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: There's no price or receipt, which is why the form kept refusing it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've supplied the warranty label and requested the correct connector.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The reference works now. No money needs to come back; I just need the part to fit.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. This is a warranty part exchange, not a refund claim.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The policy says a mattress trial lasts ninety nights, but the return assistant says thirty days.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is your mattress in the trial range or the clearance range?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Trial range. The order confirmation includes the ninety-night trial, and it's night forty-two.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That confirmation supports the longer trial. I'll ask the trial-returns team to override the generic checker.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't tell me to squeeze it into ordinary parcel packaging.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Bulky collection needs to be arranged by that team. Eligibility override and collection are still pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The mattress is clean, but I can't roll it back into its delivery box.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The trial collection team handles that packaging question. Don't force it into the original box.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I also need a collection window rather than an all-day slot.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've included that requirement. It may limit availability, so they need to confirm an actual appointment.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The checker email says rejected. Should I ignore it while the override is open?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Keep it as part of the record. The rejection is being reviewed; I haven't confirmed an override yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I was billed twice when I tried to upgrade the workspace. The first checkout timed out.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Are both entries posted charges, or is one still pending in the bank app?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: One is posted. The other has a little pending tag.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The workspace still shows the old plan, which is why I tried again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please don't retry again. I'll check the payment IDs and the plan activation event.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I can upload a screenshot with the card details hidden.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That will help confirm the two timestamps. Don't include full card numbers or credentials.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Uploaded. They are two minutes apart and the amounts match.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The second attempt created an authorization but wasn't captured. The first payment was captured successfully.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Then why haven't I got the upgrade?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Its activation event failed after payment. I've requested a replay of that event.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Does that mean you'll charge me again?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No. The replay uses the already captured payment; it must not create another charge.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The plan changed just now. The extra pending amount is still there.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The upgrade is active. I've requested release of the unused authorization, but the issuer controls when it disappears from your available balance.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay. I needed the upgrade for tomorrow, so that part is fixed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll keep the authorization-release check open until we can confirm the processor status.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thanks. Please don't describe that pending entry as a completed refund.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Card declined. Same card works elsewhere.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does checkout show a decline or a failed bank verification step?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Verification failed. The bank app had an approval request I missed.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Start one new checkout and complete the bank approval while it is open. The failed attempt wasn't charged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Approved it. Payment worked and the receipt arrived.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The order is paid once; the earlier attempt has no captured charge.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Our invoice is overdue because the bank transfer hasn't been matched. We sent it last week.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Did the transfer include the invoice reference?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It used the workspace name instead. We can provide the synthetic remittance record.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Please upload it through the secure billing form. I'll ask finance to match it by amount and transfer date.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Uploaded. Can you stop the automatic overdue emails?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested a temporary reminder hold, but the payment match and hold aren't confirmed yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The transfer amount matches exactly. There aren't any bank fees deducted.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good; that removes one common reconciliation difference. Finance still needs to locate the transfer.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The remittance record shows the settlement date, not just the date we initiated it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've highlighted that distinction for the reviewer.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The invoice currency is dollars.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Our checkout was in euros.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the invoice header in dollars, or is the total actually denominated that way?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The header is wrong. The total and card charge are both euros.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've regenerated the invoice with the correct currency header. The charged amount is unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Downloaded it. Everything says euros now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The document correction is complete; no payment adjustment was needed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: My coupon was accepted, then disappeared when I changed the billing period.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The offer is for monthly plans only. Did you switch to annual after applying it?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. There was no warning that I'd lose the coupon.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can restore monthly checkout with the offer, or keep annual at its listed price. Neither option has been paid yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Use monthly. I still want someone to fix that silent change.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The monthly preview includes the discount again. I've logged the missing warning, which remains unresolved.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The return credit note is attached to the wrong invoice in our account.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is the credit amount correct but the linked invoice reference wrong?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Exactly. The original refund already arrived. Our accounts just show the wrong order as settled.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've corrected the credit-note link without creating another refund.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The returned order is now balanced and the other invoice is open again.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Both accounting links are corrected; the existing payment reversal is unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The tax number field rejects our valid test-format number before we can pay.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: It strips the leading letters and then says too short.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Which country is selected in billing settings?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The correct one. The field formatter changes it anyway.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've reproduced the formatter problem and escalated it. We shouldn't substitute an invalid number on the invoice.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We'll wait, but payment is blocked until it accepts the correct format.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Agreed. There is no successful checkout or corrected invoice yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We tried pasting it and typing it slowly. Both remove the letters.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've noted both input methods. Does the browser language change the formatting?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No. English and the local language give the same result.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That helps isolate the country-specific formatter rather than translation.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The invoice preview has the stripped number too, so this isn't only a cosmetic error.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Agreed. I've marked the generated document as affected as well.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Could we pay first and correct the invoice later?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can't recommend issuing a known incorrect tax document. The billing team needs to provide a supported path.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please ask them to keep our quoted price while this is blocked.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That request is attached. I don't have approval to extend the quote yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We'll wait for the supported path. We have not submitted payment.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. There is no captured payment, and the tax-number issue is still open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can I change the invoice recipient without moving the workspace owner?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes, billing contact and workspace ownership are separate. Are you changing only the receipt destination?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Only receipts. Use the synthetic billing mailbox, accounts-demo@example.invalid.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've saved that contact. Owner permissions are unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The test receipt reached the synthetic inbox.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Billing delivery is confirmed. No cancellation or refund was requested.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The monthly usage invoice jumped because of one import job that retried all night.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I can see repeated processing attempts. Were you manually starting them or did they retry automatically?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Automatically.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I closed the browser after the first attempt.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've paused the retry job. The usage-charge review needs the job logs before we can adjust the invoice.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: At least it stopped growing. Can I pay the normal part now?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've requested a split review for the disputed usage. The final payable balance isn't confirmed yet.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The job ran the same rows every time. Would each retry be counted as new usage?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The usage log currently records each processing attempt. The adjustment review needs to distinguish retries caused by the service from new work.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I haven't started any other imports since. Please use that in the comparison.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've included that statement and the repeated job identifier in the review.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can I turn off automatic retries for future jobs?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The paused job won't retry again. A workspace-wide control isn't currently available; I've recorded that product request.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Your receipt shows the wrong last four digits. I used a wallet, not that card.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Wallet payments can use a device-specific payment number rather than the physical card's last digits.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The amount and time match, but I thought someone else's card paid.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Check the wallet transaction details locally. Does its device number match the receipt?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, it matches. I hadn't seen that number before.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then the receipt is correct for the wallet payment. No account correction is needed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Will every device show a different payment number?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It can, depending on how the wallet provisions it. Check the number on the device used for this payment.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I checked that device rather than the tablet, and it matches.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Good. Keep the wallet transaction record if you need to reconcile this receipt later.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We removed two members but the next invoice still bills for their seats.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Removing members doesn't automatically reduce the purchased seat count. Do you want that count reduced at renewal?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, and the settings page won't save the lower number.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll open a manual seat-change request and investigate the settings failure.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: This isn't a refund request. I just want future billing to match the seats we need.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Noted. The unused members are removed, but the purchased seat reduction hasn't been confirmed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Our purchase order reference is missing from the invoice. Finance won't process it.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Was it entered before the invoice was issued?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No, I added it in settings afterwards. I thought it would update existing invoices.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That setting applies to future invoices. I've reissued this unpaid invoice with the synthetic reference SYN-PO-404.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The new PDF has it. Finance can process it now.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The invoice reference is corrected; its amount and due date are unchanged.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: A failed payment email says our account is suspended, but the dashboard still works.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The failed payment started a grace period. The email wording shouldn't say suspension has already happened.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We changed the payment method, but the retry button is disabled.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The new method is saved. A scheduled retry is already queued, which is why the manual button is disabled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Can you tell me whether it succeeded?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Not yet. Access remains during the grace period; payment confirmation is still pending.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Why are there two invoices this month? Did I pay twice?

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: One is the original invoice and one is a corrected version. Does the original show void?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, but the email only said new invoice available.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The void invoice isn't payable. Only the corrected invoice has a posted payment.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: That clears it up.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The bank shows one payment too.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Your balance is zero, with one successful payment.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Checkout accepts the billing address, then clears it when I choose bank debit.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Does it also change the billing country or just the address lines?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Just the lines. I re-entered them three times and got the same loop.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll report the payment-method form reset. Please don't keep submitting until we know whether any debit mandate was created.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: I haven't received a mandate confirmation.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: No completed payment is visible here. The form problem and mandate check remain open.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The subscription price changed after I switched plans, but I can't see how the partial month was calculated.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The invoice separates unused old-plan time and remaining new-plan time. Do you see both adjustment lines?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. I thought the negative line was a refund coming to my card.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: It's an invoice credit applied to this upgrade, not a separate card refund. The final charge is the difference.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The dates and total now make sense. Keep the new plan.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. The upgrade is active, and no separate refund is due.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please stop emailing invoices to the old billing contact. I changed it yesterday.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: New invoices use the saved contact. Was today's email a reminder for an older invoice?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes. The reminder went to the old contact and copied the new one.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've updated the open invoice's contact too. The queued reminder already sent can't be recalled.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Okay. We need the next reminder to use only the new synthetic mailbox.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The invoice contact is corrected. I've opened a queue check to confirm there isn't another stale reminder waiting.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The payment page says zero due, but the invoice status is unpaid.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Is there a credit balance applied to the invoice?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Yes, the balance covers the full amount. No card was used.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Then it should be marked settled by credit rather than unpaid. I've corrected the status.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The balance is now reduced and the invoice says settled by credit.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The bookkeeping is consistent. No new payment or refund occurred.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The bank debit is shown as returned.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: We had enough funds, so I don't know why.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The return code refers to an inactive mandate, not insufficient funds. Did the account change recently?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: No account change. We did revoke an old mandate for another workspace.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I'll check whether that revocation affected this one. Please don't share bank credentials in the chat.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Thanks. We need a working mandate, not repeated failed debits.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: The mandate-link investigation is open. This invoice is still unpaid.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The two workspaces use the same bank account but different invoice references.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: That should not by itself mean both mandates were revoked. I'll ask for the mandate references to be compared internally.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Please don't create a fresh debit until the old one is understood.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: I've recorded that request. No new collection attempt is confirmed.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: The overdue notice is still visible.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Yes, the invoice remains unpaid while the mandate investigation continues.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Paid the invoice. Still says overdue.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: How long ago did the bank transfer settle?

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: This morning. Reference was correct this time.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Finance has matched it now. Please refresh the invoice page.

entries.speaker: customer
entries.text: Settled. Overdue banner gone.

entries.speaker: agent
entries.text: Confirmed. No balance remains on that invoice.
